context: First live-LLM validation task for the Cipher prototype. Keep the solution small; correctness matters more than elegance.
goal: Write a Python script at artifacts/fizzbuzz.py that prints the FizzBuzz sequence for numbers 1 through 20 (multiples of 3 -> 'Fizz', multiples of 5 -> 'Buzz', multiples of both -> 'FizzBuzz', otherwise the number), and provide a test proving it works.

success_criteria.description: The fizzbuzz script exists at artifacts/fizzbuzz.py
Running the script prints the FizzBuzz sequence for 1..20
A test file proving fizzbuzz works exists
